# k6 documentation: write and review docs across the three k6 repos

Curated by Skill Harbor — @grafana's skill for writing and reviewing k6 documentation across three repositories: k6-DefinitelyTyped (TypeScript types), k6-docs (user documentation) and k6 (release notes/changelog). Pick the write or review workflow, lean on the quick-reference guides (repo structure, TypeScript patterns, parallel-subagent testing workflow, agent-browser reference, troubleshooting), and follow strict critical rules: never push without asking, never chain commands with `&&` or `;`, only document user-facing features, `1.` for every numbered list item, every code example executed cleanly against k6@master before committing, and no AI attribution in commits. Honest caveats: k6-specific — only useful if you contribute to the k6 ecosystem; the full workflow expects local clones of all three repos and a working k6 build from master, which is heavyweight for a casual contributor. Apache-2.0 licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
